stem: There are many different species of rat snakes in the United States. Three species are described in the table.
instruction: Which statement BEST explains these differences in color?

options.label: A
options.text: Each snake population adapted to a different environment over time.

options.label: B
options.text: Each snake population moved to a different environment to reproduce.

options.label: C
options.text: Each individual snake changed its color to match its environment.

options.label: D
options.text: Each individual snake chose the best colors to pass to its offspring.

visual_elements: Table with three columns: Species, Color, Habitats
Rows for Texas rat snake, Yellow rat snake, Black rat snake with respective color and habitat information
